summary: getCurrentWindow() at component start throws outside Tauri (no __TAURI_INTERNALS__), so the whole App fails to mount in a plain browser or dev preview; tests mock the module and cannot catch it
evidence: TitleBar.svelte:4; App.svelte:50 renders it; tests mock getCurrentWindow (TitleBar.test.ts:11-13, App.test.ts:6-12); window.js:110 reads metadata
failure_scenario: Open http://127.0.0.1:1420 in a normal browser: blank page with TypeError reading metadata. Release is inside Tauri so unaffected.
